1.why: All eight screens are static single-card pages with no animations, banners, or pop-ups, only a plain dark Logs panel.

2.why: Bold headings, solid primary buttons, highlighted 'Next step' callouts, and colored progress chips make the important elements clearly stand out on every screen.

3.why: One focused card per page and consistent layout make items easy to locate, but the secrets and codes the user needs sit in the Logs panel below the form rather beside the input fields.

4.why: Visible progress chips and 'Next step' reminders remove the need to recall steps, but the six-part password policy and long authorization secrets must still be held in mind while typing.

5.why: No screen offers a 'remember me', autofill, show-password, or password-manager option; only bare manual email, password, and code fields are provided.

6.why: Completed steps turn green and the saved-step footer plus persistent Logs make progress recognizable, but entered data such as the email address is never redisplayed.

7.why: Most sentences are short and plain (e.g., 'We will guide you one small step at a time'), but jargon like 'server-backed' and 'approved-channel authorization secret' plus dense monospace log lines reduce clarity.

8.why: Only success banners (e.g., 'Code checked.', 'Password accepted.') appear in the walkthrough; no error state is shown, so error-message guidance cannot be confirmed.

9.why: No example inputs such as a sample email or example password format are shown anywhere; only the rule line 'At least 12 characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, symbol, and no spaces.'

10.why: The offered choices ('Open simulated recovery link' vs 'Enter a code manually') are clearly worded, but the text link is visually weaker than the buttons and no alternative login methods are presented.

11.why: Each screen presents at most one primary action plus two secondary buttons (e.g., Confirm channel / Send again / Start again), never too many choices at once.

12.why: Green status banners after every action ('Password changed.', 'Authenticated account session active.', 'Confirmation recorded...') clearly inform the outcome of each action.

13.why: Every screen shows a 'Next step:' tip plus a persistent 'Get help and safety advice' link and pause/support notes.

14.why: 'Send the authorization secret again', 'Start recovery again', and 'Restart password recovery' buttons together with no-timeout pause messaging make it easy to try again.

15.why: The header, progress chips, card layout, callout style, and footer are identical across all eight screens, so the design stays consistent and learnable.
